capabilities: Expand numeric citation ranges and mixed groups
Show all references in one scrollable hover card
Jump to a reference in the source note
Report missing or duplicate reference numbers
Recognize plain-text and linked citation forms
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from a GitHub release. Desktop mouse hover is the primary interaction, with no tap-to-preview gesture on touchscreens. Operates locally with no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's built-in hover preview shows only a single link target, so a numeric citation range like [1–10] cannot display all of its references together.
summary: Hover preview that expands numeric citation ranges and groups into one scrollable card listing the note's bibliography entries.
